coptic: Ⲡⲉⲱ̀ⲟⲩ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲧⲉⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ.

translations.english: Your glory O Mary, is higher than the heaven, you are more honored than the earth, and its inhabitants.
translations.arabic: مجدِك يا مريم، أرفع من السماء، وأنت أكرم من الأرض، وسكانها.

transliterations.english: Pe-oou Maria: chosi ehote etfe: tetaieeout e-epkahi: nem nee-etshop enkheetf.

sung.english: glory O Mary, is higher than heaven, you are more honored than the earth, and its inhabitants.

coptic: Ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲧⲉ ϯⲥ̀ⲧⲣⲁⲧⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲉⲧⲟⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲙ̀ⲙⲟϣⲓ: ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀.

translations.english: For you are truly, the real path, leading up, to the heavens.
translations.arabic: لأنكِ أنتِ بالحقيقة، الطريق الحقيقي، المؤدي، إلى السموات.

transliterations.english: Entho ghar aleethos: te ti-estrata emmee: etoi emma-emmoshi: e-epshoi enifeeoui.

coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϯϩⲓⲱϯ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲙⲟⲣϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϫⲟⲙ: ⲱ̀ ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ.

translations.english: You are clothed, with joy and gladness, and girdled with power, O daughter of Zion.
translations.arabic: لبسِت الفرح، والتهليل، وتمنطقتِ بالقوة، يا إبنة صهيون.

transliterations.english: Aretihioti: emefrashi nem eptheleel: aremorti enougom: o etsheri ension.

coptic: Ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥϯϩⲓⲱⲧⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϩⲉⲃⲥⲱ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲥϩⲱⲃⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲇⲁⲙ: ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϩⲉⲃⲥⲱ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ.

translations.english: O who was clothed, with the garments of the heavenly, so that you covered Adam, with the garments of grace.
translations.arabic: يا مَنْ لبسِت، لباس السمائيين، حتى سترتِ آدم، بلباس النعمة.

transliterations.english: O thee-etastihiots: enethevso enna nifeeoui: sha enteshovs enadam: enethevso empi-ehmot.

coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟϥ ⲛ̀ⲕⲉⲥⲟⲡ: ⲉ̀Ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲓⲥⲟⲥ: ⲡ̀ⲧⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ: ⲫ̀ⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ.

translations.english: And restored him again, to the Paradise, the rejoicing place, and dwelling of the righteous.
translations.arabic: ورددته مرة أخري، إلى الفردوس، موضع الفرح، ومسكن الصديقين.

transliterations.english: Aretastof enkesop: epiparathisos: eptopos emepounof: efma enshopi ennithikeos.

sung.english: And restored him, to Paradise, the place of joy, and the dwelling of the righteous.
